19.t: Working with data: germination and temperature
q: State the best temperature for germination.
Enzymes in the seed work slowly in the cold, so it cannot break down its food store fast enough to grow in 7 days.
Explain why no seeds germinated at 45 °C, and suggest how the method could be improved.
High temperature denatures the enzymes (and may dry the seeds). Improve: repeat each tray, test more temperatures between 25 and 40 °C, keep water the same.
